plugins.description: Lean harness-engineering plugin: four pillars (architecture guardrails, documentation as system of record, observability & legibility, entropy management) enforced as repo-local mechanical constraints. Composes with gstack (v1.46+ floor, v1.84.1 current; reconciles its content-addressed review verdicts read-only) for delivery — never orchestrates. Emits a versioned verify/review decision-signal Gate API (docs/SIGNALS.md) rendered as a SessionStart/Stop gate ladder that Dynamic Workflows, Agent Teams and the pre-ship check gate on; ships /oh-my-agents:harness-audit.
